plan.purpose: Bounded feasibility check of image-to-structured-content extraction; not full-book acceptance or accuracy estimation
plan.structuredMode: json_object plus local JSON Schema validation; not provider-enforced full schema
plan.inputs: Original full page images, selected region/scope, generic extraction rules, schema and existing candidate definition catalog. No reference instances, element values, answers, expected checks or screenshots are supplied.
decisions: API/transport failures are not semantic failures
Malformed or truncated output is retained without silent repair
An authorization or image-capability error stops dispatching remaining calls
No prompt tuning or automatic repair within this batch
Equivalent mathematical expressions and object IDs are reviewed semantically, not rejected by string inequality
Source and reconstruction review is performed by the author, not an independent human reviewer
Keep extracted output separate from the manually curated reference
criteria: All selected source requirements and values are accounted for
Question, source solution and generated explanation remain separate
Typed contents render without substituting missing data from the reference
Existing Task/Solution/KC associations are valid or uncertain status is explicit
Changes needed from the reference are recorded per case; no universal pass-rate target
